protected_functions.description: Preserve the exact owner-final Introduction in articles/somatic-therapies/OWNER-FINAL-INTRODUCTION-20260902.txt as controlling authority for that bounded section until exact raw-editor HTML assembly is completed. Do not reconstruct it from an older model candidate.

Preserve the owner-accepted article argument that CBT/exposure have real strengths in reality testing, behavioral experiments, prediction testing, avoidance work, and cognitive updating, but were inadequate as a complete account/treatment of trauma; somatic alternatives were developed to address processes those approaches missed. Bodily signals deserve investigation rather than automatic obedience or automatic dismissal. CBT is cross-cutting, not confined to Stage 5.

Preserve the owner-accepted interpretation that Somatic Experiencing was developed to address inadequacies in prevailing cognitive/verbal/exposure approaches, while not misstating CBT/exposure as useless. Payne/Levine/Crane-Godreau's explicit critique of simple conditioning/talk-therapy adequacy and bottom-up alternative supports this interpretation. Do not require a literal one-sentence motive declaration before allowing the supported causal inference.

Preserve the five-stage therapeutic map as Joel's practical second-half map, not the article's entire intellectual thesis and not a scientifically validated universal protocol. Joel rejected `job` article-wide and accepted `stage` as the reader-facing label.
Preserve the warning that capacity-building should not become indefinite avoidance of actual trauma treatment; its accepted destination is Stage 1.
Preserve the Nurturer/Protector, borrowed-adulthood, gentle present-focused self-hypnosis, heart-to-solar-plexus love-loop material, and the function that more than one stage can be active at once.

Preserve supplied personal/material voice anchors including Professor Baby Sheep, Joel's head-shaving/massage experience with loveyhuasca, Louka's report about the linked Shaking Qigong class, and the confirmed intentional phrase `one-one` unless Joel changes them.

Preserve the substantive safety boundaries: stop/return capacity, neck support during tremoring, non-coercive yoga, post-session integration, caution stacking intense modalities, and Sky Hypnosis/Vagal Blitz physical and mental-health cautions.

Preserve distinctions among published research, clinical practice, personal experience, community signal, traditional/energetic explanations, and proposed mechanisms. Do not imply evidence equivalence when comparing CBT, SE, TRE, Focusing, Sensorimotor, Alexander Technique, or 5Rhythms.
Preserve the eight native/editor objects, their exact identity/metadata, and source positions unless publication-source evidence or Joel authorizes a change.

owner_review.evidence: Joel finalized the Introduction on 2026-09-02. On 2026-09-03 he accepted the whole-sequence five-stage architecture, rejected `job`, accepted retiring the duplicate Map section, then accepted the larger CBT/somatic epistemology reorganization. He directly corrected the model's overly narrow reading of the SE genealogy: existing cognitive/verbal/exposure approaches were inadequate as a complete trauma model/treatment, and this inadequacy is part of why somatic alternatives such as SE were developed. The overall article remains working, not owner-final or published.
